description: This header file defines a class `dm_ieee_1905_security_list_t` that manages the IEEE 1905 security list, including initialization, retrieval, update, deletion, synchronization with a database, and configuration setting. It is part of a security module handling IEEE 1905 security information within a mesh network.

classes.name: dm_ieee_1905_security_list_t
classes.description: A class managing the list of IEEE 1905 security entries, providing functions for initialization, retrieval, update, deletion, database synchronization, and configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the IEEE 1905 security list, setting up necessary structures.

methods.name: em_ieee_1905_security_info_t * get_ieee_1905_security_info()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal security info structure.

methods.name: dm_ieee_1905_security_t * get_first()
methods.description: Retrieves the first security entry in the list.

methods.name: dm_ieee_1905_security_t * get_next(dm_ieee_1905_security_t * net_ssid)
methods.description: Retrieves the next security entry given the current one.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Determines the DM orchestration type based on a database client and security settings.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the security list with a given security object and operation type.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the security list.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Sets up the security table data structures.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initializes the columns of the security list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the security database with the provided database client and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the database with provided data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for an entry matching the given key.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration data within the database, given a JSON object and parent ID.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration details into a JSON object.
